import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu

B62_TXT="""   A  R  N  D  C  Q  E  G  H  I  L  K  M  F  P  S  T  W  Y  V
A  4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
R -1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C  0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G  0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
K -1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S  1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
T  0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
V  0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
rr=B62_TXT.strip().split("\n");AAs=rr[0].split()
IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
SM=np.full((25,25),-4.0)
for r_ in rr[1:]:
    p=r_.split()
    for aa,v in zip(AAs,p[1:]): SM[IDX[p[0]],IDX[aa]]=float(v)
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,0) for c in s])

def nw_id(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    """vectorised-row affine NW, returns % identity over aligned pairs"""
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);NEG=-1e9
    e2=enc(s2)
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    pM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pX=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);pY=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0.;Ix[1:,0]=0.;Iy[0,1:]=0.;pX[1:,0]=1;pY[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        row=SM[IDX.get(s1[i-1],0)][e2]
        C=np.vstack([M[i-1,:-1],Ix[i-1,:-1],Iy[i-1,:-1]])
        k=C.argmax(0);M[i,1:]=C[k,np.arange(m)]+row;pM[i,1:]=k
        g1,g2=np.full(m,go),np.full(m,ge); g1[-1]=0.;g2[-1]=0.
        C=np.vstack([M[i-1,1:]+g1,Ix[i-1,1:]+g2]);k=C.argmax(0)
        Ix[i,1:]=C[k,np.arange(m)];pX[i,1:]=np.where(k==0,0,1)
        for j in range(1,m+1):   # Iy has intra-row dependency
            a=M[i,j-1]+(go if i<n else 0.); b=Iy[i,j-1]+(ge if i<n else 0.)
            if a>=b: Iy[i,j]=a;pY[i,j]=0
            else: Iy[i,j]=b;pY[i,j]=2
            if Iy[i,j]>Ix[i,j] or True: pass
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));ident=tot=0
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st=2
        elif j==0: st=1
        if st==0:
            tot+=1; ident+= (s1[i-1]==s2[j-1]); ns=pM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=ns
        elif st==1: ns=pX[i,j];i-=1;st=ns
        else: ns=pY[i,j];j-=1;st=ns
    return 100.0*ident/tot

def uni(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")
    return "".join(t[1:])
IDS={"P53590":"Pig SUCLG2 (G-type)","A0A9P6TY68":"A.ambigua SUCLG2 TARGET",
     "A0A9P6Q632":"A.ambigua TCA9 (A-type)","O97580":"Pig SUCLA2 (A-type)",
     "B3FHP0":"Blastocystis beta","P0A836":"E.coli SucC"}
sq={k:uni(k) for k in IDS}
refs=["P53590","O97580"]
rows=[]
for q in ["A0A9P6TY68","A0A9P6Q632","B3FHP0","P0A836"]:
    r={"protein":IDS[q]}
    for rf in refs: r[f"%id vs {IDS[rf]}"]=round(nw_id(sq[q],sq[rf]),1)
    r["delta (G minus A)"]=round(r[f"%id vs {IDS['P53590']}"]-r[f"%id vs {IDS['O97580']}"],1)
    rows.append(r)
idt=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("=== subfamily placement: % identity to the two measured animal paralogs ===")
print(idt.to_string(index=False))
print("\nPig SUCLG2 vs pig SUCLA2 themselves: %.1f%%"%nw_id(sq["P53590"],sq["O97580"]))

allr=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(label="Pig SUCLG2 (G-type)",cls="GTP",net_q_8A=0,net_q_10A=-4,net_q_12A=-3,net_q_15A=-1),
 dict(label="Human SUCLG2 (G-type)",cls="GTP",net_q_8A=1,net_q_10A=-4,net_q_12A=-3,net_q_15A=-1),
 dict(label="T. aquaticus SCS (3UFX:B)",cls="GTP",net_q_8A=1,net_q_10A=-1,net_q_12A=-1,net_q_15A=0),
 dict(label="E. coli SucC",cls="ATP",net_q_8A=0,net_q_10A=-3,net_q_12A=-1,net_q_15A=1),
 dict(label="Pig SUCLA2 (A-type)",cls="ATP",net_q_8A=2,net_q_10A=-3,net_q_12A=-1,net_q_15A=-1),
 dict(label="Human SUCLA2 (A-type)",cls="ATP",net_q_8A=3,net_q_10A=-2,net_q_12A=-1,net_q_15A=-1),
 dict(label="Blastocystis SCS-beta",cls="ATP",net_q_8A=1,net_q_10A=-1,net_q_12A=3,net_q_15A=4),
 dict(label="A. ambigua SUCLG2 TARGET",cls="?",net_q_8A=0,net_q_10A=-4,net_q_12A=-2,net_q_15A=0),
 dict(label="A. ambigua TCA9 (A-type)",cls="?",net_q_8A=2,net_q_10A=-2,net_q_12A=-1,net_q_15A=1)])
m=allr[allr.cls!="?"]
print("\n=== electrostatics with all 3 measured GTP-preferring enzymes (n=3 vs 4) ===")
for col in ["net_q_8A","net_q_10A","net_q_12A","net_q_15A"]:
    g=sorted(m[m.cls=="GTP"][col]);a=sorted(m[m.cls=="ATP"][col])
    u,p=mannwhitneyu(g,a,alternative="two-sided")
    print(f"  {col:10s} GTP={g}  ATP={a}  overlap={sorted(set(g)&set(a))}  p={p:.3f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13.5,5))
ax=axes[0];x=[8,10,12,15];cols=["net_q_8A","net_q_10A","net_q_12A","net_q_15A"]
for _,r in allr.iterrows():
    st,c,lw={"GTP":("-o","#2f6fb5",1.5),"ATP":("-s","#c0392b",1.5),"?":("--^","#111111",2.2)}[r["cls"]]
    ax.plot(x,[r[k] for k in cols],st,color=c,lw=lw,ms=6,label=r["label"])
ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.8);ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xlabel("radius around nucleotide base pocket (A)");ax.set_ylabel("net formal charge of side chains")
ax.set_title("Charge around the nucleotide site does not separate\nmeasured GTP-preferring (blue) from ATP-preferring (red) enzymes",fontsize=10)
ax.legend(fontsize=7,loc="lower right")
ax2=axes[1]
lbl=idt["protein"].tolist();gv=idt["%id vs Pig SUCLG2 (G-type)"];av=idt["%id vs Pig SUCLA2 (A-type)"]
yp=np.arange(len(lbl))
ax2.barh(yp-0.2,gv,0.4,color="#2f6fb5",label="vs pig SUCLG2 (GTP-specific)")
ax2.barh(yp+0.2,av,0.4,color="#c0392b",label="vs pig SUCLA2 (ATP-specific)")
for i,(a_,b_) in enumerate(zip(gv,av)):
    ax2.text(a_+0.6,i-0.2,f"{a_:.0f}",va="center",fontsize=8)
    ax2.text(b_+0.6,i+0.2,f"{b_:.0f}",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax2.set_yticks(yp);ax2.set_yticklabels(lbl,fontsize=9);ax2.invert_yaxis()
ax2.set_xlabel("% identity (global alignment, free end gaps)")
ax2.set_title("Subfamily placement against the two measured animal paralogs",fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(fontsize=8,loc="lower right");ax2.set_xlim(0,80)
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
allr.to_csv("electrostatics_final.csv",index=False);idt.to_csv("subfamily_identity.csv",index=False)
print("\nsaved electrostatics_final.csv, subfamily_identity.csv")
